cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.
